limits: TerraDS has no fork flag. A fork that diverged below Jaccard 0.8 in every rule is not detected: how many such forks exist is not yet established.
Copies whose files were renamed or split are found only through rules b, c and d.
Rule d compares token windows of the module's own files; a copy that reorders or inlines its files into another structure is not recognised unless the windows still overlap.

method.computed_over: every candidate that passed E01 to E08 (natives and hosts together)
method.id: lin- + the smallest repository id of the component, zero-padded to 12 digits
rules: b: identical normalised module text (comments and whitespace stripped; per-file hashes combined in sorted order)
c: for modules with two or more files each, at least 50 percent of the files share a normalised hash; a file counts only from 30 normalised tokens up (user decision, 30 Oct 2026)
d: 5-token shingle Jaccard of at least 0.8, found with MinHash (64 permutations, 16 bands of 4 rows, seed 20261030) and confirmed by exact Jaccard
